notes.title: Small version of the game is ready!
notes.content: A small version of the game is ready! From this day on, the game will be available and constantly updated! Dear players! You can also participate in the development of the game! Write what you would like in the game!

notes.title: New multiplayer
notes.content:
A lot of work has been done. Added basic functionality for playing multiplayer. What did it give? Optimization, speed and the ability to add new functionality. Do not perceive that this is the finally game. Everything can change. Also write what you would like to see in the game!

[previewyoutube=c9Np1sxUk3Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Map editor for game
notes.content:
A difficult job has been done! A map editor was made for the game! We'll have to wait a little longer and the game will be available!  I will be very happy if users follow the development of the game. And also support and help me! And I hope that you will definitely like everything I do!
[previewyoutube=FilJgiiBqzs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Map editor
notes.content:
Dear players! Currently, the development of a map editor for the game, which will be integrated into the game, is actively underway.

notes.title: All right guys! Thanks for the support! There will be a remaster of the game!
notes.content: It doesn't matter for what reason you bought the game! I want people to be able to launch and play at any time! Moreover, I want to remake the game for several reasons. While there will be a small demo version or just a launcher. If you wait, there will be a remaster of the game!
